$comment: Part II manifest — the hand-authored administrative sections of Part II (economic operator). Part II is MIXED: these admin blocks (A: EO identity, B: power of attorney) are interleaved with the economic-operator OT criteria within the EA section structure (espd-edm.json). build-ui-bundle.mjs places each section's members — admin blocks from here, criteria from the form-structure — in EA document order. Title/description keys are i18n keys (part.title.II etc.) that the consuming application resolves.
